verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a RESTful API supporting GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE. Its official MCP server lets agents create and configure sites, open change requests, draft content, edit pages and restructure docs, and the docs state you can "drive it from your agent". This covers much of the core authoring workflow programmatically, but nothing claims or demonstrates full UI parity. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that admin features (branding, custom domains, authenticated access, analytics, AI insights) are reachable via API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes at candidate paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
